description.value: Treed municipal campground in the centre of Nakusp, three blocks from the Arrow Lake public beach, with flush washrooms and heated showers; open from May 1 with nightly fees for non-serviced tent sites.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (nakuspcampground.ca) loaded successfully and is the primary evidence source, providing address (900 4th St NW, Nakusp, BC V0G 1R0), phone (250-265-1061), and explicit amenity confirmation including 'central washrooms with heated showers,' Wi-Fi, fire pits, and an online booking system with a detailed cancellation policy.
